name: Outsidaz
description: The '''Outsidaz''' were an American [[Hip hop music|hip hop]] collective from [[Newark, New Jersey]], perhaps best known through their affiliation and collaborations with fellow [[New York metropolitan area|Tri-State area]] rap trio [[Fugees]] and [[Metro Detroit|Detroit-area]] rap group [[D12]]. Past members included [[Eminem]], [[Rah Digga]], and [[Pacewon|Pace Won]] among others. In 2001, members of the collective released their only studio album to date, ''[[The Bricks (album)|The Bricks]].''
